mapper.select: SELECT f.field_name, SUM(d.numeric_value) AS total FROM report_submissions s JOIN report_submission_data d ON d.submission_id = s.id JOIN report_template_fields f ON f.id = d.field_id WHERE s.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND s.status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received') AND f.field_type = 'number' GROUP BY f.field_name

SELECT f.field_name AS fieldName, SUM(d.numeric_value) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS cnt FROM report_submission_data d JOIN report_submissions s ON d.submission_id = s.id JOIN report_template_fields f ON f.id = d.field_id JOIN report_assignments a ON s.assignment_id = a.id INNER JOIN ( SELECT assignment_id, MAX(version) AS max_version FROM report_submissions WHERE status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received') GROUP BY assignment_id ) latest ON s.assignment_id = latest.assignment_id AND s.version = latest.max_version WHERE a.template_id = #{templateId} AND a.period_label = #{periodLabel} AND s.status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received') AND f.field_type = 'number' AND f.data_type = 'summary' AND f.status = 'active' AND d.row_index = 0 GROUP BY f.field_name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM report_submissions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND status IN ('pending_receipt', 'received')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_aggregations (template_id, assignment_id, aggregated_data, branch_count, submitted_count) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{assignmentId}, #{aggregatedData}, #{branchCount}, #{submittedCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE aggregated_data = VALUES(aggregated_data), submitted_count = VALUES(submitted_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
INSERT INTO assignment_recalls (assignment_id, recalled_by, issuer_department_id, reason) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{recalledBy}, #{issuerDepartmentId}, #{reason})
